name: devports
author: jakedx6
description: Every dev server and Docker container you left running, grouped by project, with CPU, memory, ports and a safe stop. A bar count plus a full terminal UI and a CLI for scripts and agents.

barWidget.description: How many projects have dev servers or containers running. Hover for the list, click to open the devports TUI.

schema.label: Project folders
schema.description: Colon-separated folders to watch, e.g. ~/code:~/work. Empty uses DEVPORTS_ROOTS or the usual folders (~/Projects, ~/code, ~/src, …).
